description: Return temporal metrics (frequency, sequence gaps, latency percentiles) for a DDS topic over a recent window as a `TopicMetrics`. **Read `status` first**: `unsupported_user_topic` means the payload is not decoded, so no metric exists: every null or 0 is not a measurement; `no_samples_yet` is a builtin topic with nothing buffered; `ok` means computed. **Limits**: the buffer is filled only when `peek_dds_samples` runs on the topic, so `observed_frequency_hz` reflects how often it was called, not the publish rate: a coarse presence signal. `declared_frequency_hz` is `1 / deadline` of the shortest writer Deadline announced in discovery (declared, not measured; null when none). Also `sequence_gaps_count`, `latency_ns_p50/p95/p99` and availability flags. **Read-only by architecture**. **Raises an MCP error** when no DDS module is active or `window_s` is outside 1..3600. Right after start the call waits up to 3 s for discovery. **Duration**: uses the DDS binding behind the DDS lock (one call at a time); the whole call, lock wait included, ends within 45 s, and if another DDS call holds the lock it fails at once with a `busy` error (retry).

domain_id.description: Ignored: it does not switch domains and is only range-checked (0..232). The domain observed is the one joined at startup (`TOPICFORGE_DDS_DOMAIN_ID`), reported in the response `domain_id`; `note` flags a different non-zero value.

topic.description: DDS topic name: bare (`scan`), ROS 2 mangled (`rt/scan`) or a builtin discovery topic (`DCPSParticipant`, `DCPSSubscription`, `DCPSPublication`). Letters, digits, `_`, `/` and `::` only.

name: topic_metrics

outputSchema.description: Temporal metrics for a single DDS topic over a recent window.

declared_frequency_hz.description: `1 / deadline` of the shortest writer Deadline announced: the promised rate, not the observed one; `None` when none announced.

latency_available.description: True when a sample carried both a publish and a receive timestamp.

latency_ns_p50.description: Median publish-to-receive latency in ns; `None` unless `latency_available`.

samples_observed.description: Samples buffered in the window. `0` does NOT mean no publisher, only that no `peek_dds_samples` call captured one.

sequence_gaps_count.description: Missing sequence numbers in the buffered samples; `0` also when none exist (see `sequence_numbers_available`).

sequence_numbers_available.description: True when a sequence number could be read from a sample.

status.description: `ok`; `no_samples_yet` (empty buffer); `unsupported_user_topic` (payload not decoded: null fields are not measurements).

window_actual_s.description: Seconds actually covered; shorter than `window_s` after a recent start; `0.0` without samples.

outputSchema.title: TopicMetrics

title: Topic metrics
